_comment: Regions are fractions of the ORIGINAL slide image: [left, top, right, bottom]. They are deliberately generous because the label shifts a little from slide to slide. 'pattern' validates the normalized value; a value that fails it is kept but marked invalid_format. Edit freely and rerun the lab notebook.

individual_id.prompt: This crop shows a large black bird ID code on a white label, formatted like 'A 0012 H' or 'BB 17692' (1-2 letters, 4-5 digits, optional trailing letter). Read it exactly.

species.prompt: This crop shows a row with a 5-letter species code in capitals (e.g. HAFLU), possibly followed by an unrelated note such as '3K+' on the right. Return ONLY the 5-letter species code, not the note.

age.prompt: This crop shows the age code in a coloured box at the top-left of a specimen label, like '2K+', '1K' or '3K'. Return only that code.

sex.prompt: This crop shows a single letter for the bird's sex in a grey box at the top-right of a specimen label (usually M or F). Return only that letter.

feather.prompt: This crop shows a line of red text describing the feather, near the top of a specimen slide. Part of it may be hidden under a black board or feathers. Transcribe only the characters you can actually see in THIS image; put '...' where text is hidden. Do not invent or complete words.

date.prompt: This crop shows a date in blue text at the bottom-right of a specimen slide, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Return only the date.

answer_rules: Answer with JSON only: {"value": <text or null>, "visible": "yes" | "partly" | "no", "confidence": <0-1>}. Use visible=no and value=null ONLY if that text is truly absent or fully covered in the crop; never guess characters you cannot see.
